subject: Insurance
title: The Pillow Pyro
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Pillow Pyro usable.

hook.text: John Orr was a fire captain and arson investigator who set over 2,000 fires in California during the 1980s and 1990s.

buildup.text: Orr investigated fires he himself set.

discovery.text: A fingerprint on an incendiary device at a conference finally linked Orr to the fires.

twist.text: Orr's fires killed four people, including a baby.

climax.text: Orr was convicted and sentenced to life without parole.

punchline.text: 2,000 fires, investigated by the arsonist himself.

quiz.question: What was unique about John Orr's arson case?
options: He was the arson investigator investigating his own fires
